framing: These are hypotheses to check, not diagnoses. Each row is a cause that open-access papers associate with a WM-811K defect pattern, quoted exactly with its location. The papers state these links briefly, mostly by citing older work; none was tested on this fab's data, and no source read gives direct experimental evidence for a pattern-to-cause link. Confidence rates the support in the literature read: medium = stated by two or more papers that cite different earlier sources; low = stated by one paper, or by an unreviewed preprint without a citation. High is not used.

causes.label: Center
causes.hypothesis: Associated in several papers with problems in thin-film deposition (one adds the plasma area).

quotes.quote: Center and Edge-Ring are caused by thin film deposition and etching problems, respectively
quotes.location: Section 1, Introduction (citing refs. 4 and 5: Piao et al. 2018; Jin et al. 2019)

quotes.quote: A center often arises due to problems in the thin film deposition
the center type has the effect of problems in the plasma area or thin-film deposition
quotes.location: Experiment, Data description (citing ref. 28: Hansen and Thyregod 1998)

causes.label: Center
causes.hypothesis: Associated in one paper with uneven mechanical polishing or abnormal liquid pressure.

quotes.quote: For example, the Center pattern means that the mechanical polishing is uneven, or the pressure of the liquid is abnormal.

causes.label: Center
causes.hypothesis: A circular, center-located pattern is associated in one paper with chemical stains or mechanical equipment faults.

quotes.quote: often corresponds to chemical stains or mechanical equipment faults
quotes.location: I. Introduction, about a circular-shaped, center-located pattern (citing refs. 2 and 3)

causes.label: Donut
causes.hypothesis: A center-located donut pattern is associated in one paper with possible tooling problems.

quotes.quote: is routinely observed in wafer data due to possible tooling problems
quotes.location: I. Introduction, about a center-located, donut-shaped pattern (citing ref. 5)

causes.label: Edge-Loc
causes.hypothesis: Associated in one paper with uneven heating during the diffusion process.

quotes.quote: the edge-loc type has the same effect as uneven heating during the diffusion process.
quotes.location: Experiment, Data description (sentence citing ref. 28: Hansen and Thyregod 1998)

causes.label: Edge-Loc
causes.hypothesis: A zone-shaped, edge-located pattern (closest to Edge-Loc) is associated in one paper with uneven polishing or edge-die effects.

quotes.quote: can be traced to uneven polishing or edge-die effects
quotes.location: I. Introduction, about a zone-shaped, edge-located pattern (citing ref. 4)

causes.label: Edge-Ring
causes.hypothesis: Associated in two papers with problems in the etching step.

quotes.quote: Center and Edge-Ring are caused by thin film deposition and etching problems, respectively
quotes.location: Section 1, Introduction (citing refs. 4 and 5: Piao et al. 2018; Jin et al. 2019)

quotes.quote: a ring is due to problems in the etching step

causes.label: Edge-Ring
causes.hypothesis: Associated in one paper with abnormal temperature control during annealing.

quotes.quote: Abnormal temperature control during annealing may lead to an Edge-Ring pattern.

causes.label: Loc
causes.hypothesis: Associated, in one unreviewed preprint and without a citation, with localized contamination or particles.

quotes.quote: often resulting from localized contamination or particle interference.
quotes.location: Section III.A, Data Collection, item V (Local); no citation

causes.label: Near-full
causes.hypothesis: Associated, in one unreviewed preprint and without a citation, with major process malfunctions or equipment failures.

quotes.quote: typically signifying major process malfunctions or equipment failures.
quotes.location: Section III.A, Data Collection, item VI (Near-Full); no citation

causes.label: Random
causes.hypothesis: Randomly scattered failing dies are associated in two papers with ordinary process variation or a poorly controlled process environment, not with one assignable source.

quotes.quote: since they are merely artifacts of random process variation.
quotes.location: I. Introduction, about randomly scattered defective chips

quotes.quote: is often due to a lack of process environment management or factors that are difficult to control directly.
quotes.location: Section 3.2, Random Noise Filtering and Data Augmentation (about random noise, not the Random class)

causes.label: Scratch
causes.hypothesis: Associated in several papers with wafer handling by machines, or with the moving or cutting steps.

quotes.quote: Scratch is caused by machine handling
quotes.location: Section 1, Introduction (citing refs. 4 and 5: Piao et al. 2018; Jin et al. 2019)

quotes.quote: a scratch is a result of machine handing problems
quotes.location: Section 1, Introduction (citing Wang and Bensmail 2006); "handing" is as printed

quotes.quote: The Scratch pattern indicates an exception in the moving or cutting processes.
